key_points: Stock showed significant intraday volatility (up ~3-6%) driven by mixed earnings-related commentary and analyst coverage
Morgan Stanley bullish note citing potential 80% upside amid hard-disk drive (HDD) recovery narrative is a positive fundamental catalyst
Cramer caution on data center capacity shrinkage introduces downside risk to near-term demand outlook
Small-cap institutional flows (Sumitomo buy, Parkway sell) are likely noise rather than meaningful directional signals
Valuation concerns persist with GuruFocus flagging overvaluation relative to fair value estimates
